title: A CACHE TAG CLEARS ITS OWN RING
why: Seen on the 4K map screenshot of 2026-10-08: with the map tags grown at 4K (v19.63), a CACHE tag sat so close above its marker that the ring ran through its letters. It sits a little higher now, clear of the ring at any size.
now: CACHE tags on the sector map sit clear of their rings.

edits.replacement: mapLabel(CQ.opened?'LOOTED':'CACHE',qx,qy-20*_MZ,'#e6b4ff');   // v16.xx, seen on the 4K map (2026-10-08): clear of its own ring (up to 12 above the centre) at the grown text size
